text:
anya: Quick design review — autoscale onboarding wizard draft ready for feedback. Focus: how we surface min/max suggestions, burst activation confirmation, and the SLO anchoring copy.
marcus: sharing screen now, but quick note — the min field is still ambiguous to PMs. They keep asking if min is 'reserved' or 'guaranteed'.
dena: we should call it out in-line: 'Min (guaranteed baseline) — capacity reserved for this pool' maybe with an i tooltip.
sarah: agree. tooltip text should be 1 sentence + one line about cost impact. Keep it scannable.
ken: Accessibility: contrast on the SLO slider handle fails 3:1 against bg at narrow widths. Need darker handle or an outline.
anya: noted on contrast. I'll try a 16% darker handle and test. Also thinking about SLO anchoring copy: right now it reads 'Target latency (p50)'. We should avoid p50 for PMs — maybe 'Target latency (median)'.
marcus: yes, swap to 'median (p50)' to keep both worlds. Also add micro-copy: 'Used to compute fallback rules and burst thresholds'.
dena: Burst activation modal — UX nit: current CTA 'Activate burst' is vague. Users expected 'Activate now' or 'Enable burst capacity'.
sarah: 'Enable burst capacity' is better for clarity. Also we need a confirmation step showing cost delta: 'Estimated cost per hour: +$X' — and a small 'Why?' link.
anya: good call. UX question: do we show cost delta inline or only after clicking confirm? My read: show inline but collapsed, with a chevron to expand details.
ken: screen reader note: when the user opens 'burst details' region, ensure ARIA-expanded updates and focus moves to heading.
marcus: Error handling: if user sets min > max, current validation only highlights fields but no message. Suggest inline error: 'Min must be <= Max' plus suggested fix 'Set Max to 2x Min' (we can compute suggestion).
dena: love the suggested fix. Also consider adding a micro-suggestion when min is 0 — 'Consider setting min to 1 if you need steady warm workers' — helpful for cold start caveats.
anya: copy suggestions for the reserved capacity badge: original 'Guaranteed' -> change to 'Reserved for this pool' per earlier note.
sarah: Also add a small tooltip on Reserved: 'Reserved capacity is billed regardless of usage.' Must be blunt for finance teams.
marcus: Pool selection dropdown — current ordering is alphabetical. For new users, defaulting to 'Recommended pool' (based on region + cost + recent usage) is more helpful. We need copy to explain recommendation: 'Recommended: lowest latency for your region'.
ken: keyboard nav: pool dropdown needs predictable focus order and press-enter to select. We lost that on last iteration.
dena: visual affordance when switching pools: show a transient callout 'Switching to pool X may change latency and cost. Review changes' with link to a cost preview.
anya: for the SLO slider guardrails: show a small red line when user drifts below our safety floor. Also a subtle tooltip 'At this SLO risk, we recommend enabling burst'.
sarah: microcopy for canary rollouts: 'Canary size (% of traffic) — recommended 5%.' Maybe add 'Auto rollback on error rate > 2x baseline'.
marcus: design question: should all these helper copies be collapsed behind a 'Need help?' drawer or inline? My preference is inline for first-time users, collapsed on small screens.
dena: inline but hide on small screens makes sense. We'll audit mobile later.
ken: accessibility final checks: ensure contrast, aria-labels for all slider handles, and focus order consistency on the wizard.
anya: next steps — I'll push updated mock with: 1) change labels ('Min (Reserved)'), 2) contrast tweak, 3) burst modal with cost delta collapsed by default, 4) inline validation and suggested fix texts, 5) recommended pool as default plus explanation.
marcus: timeline: can we get a clickable prototype by Thursday? Product review on Friday.
anya: aiming EOD Wednesday for v2, clickable by Thursday afternoon.
sarah: I'll write final copy notes and drop them into the Figma comments.
dena: I'll prep accessibility checklist and run Lighthouse on the prototype once ready.
ux-bot: Reminder set: review-prototype @ 1794180000 (Thursday 10:00) — react with :eyes: if attending.
ken: +1 — I'll be there.
marcus: thanks everyone — great feedback, super actionable.
